goal: Build a durable internal AI-session handback workflow on canonical Nilaza Growth roles and evidence, render one real bilingual creative, independently review it and stop awaiting Owner review.
successCriteria: A local CLI prepares a source-hashed job, accepts an actual AI-session author packet, renders real VI/EN PNG creative and persists independent hash-bound QA and an Owner review bundle.
Idempotent replay does not duplicate work; bounded renderer retry and explicit crash reconciliation never fabricate a model call, QA, human approval or product KPI.
Sensitive or foreign-tenant data, unsafe paths, stale sources, corrupted outputs, self-review and unsupported external approval fail closed.
Canonical eight roles remain the operating model; hypotheses and future freemium/pricing/ads direction are clearly separated from shipped product facts.
No provider installation, credentials, API calls, deployments, database/email/ad changes or existing Admin/mobile/source snapshot edits occur.
untouchedSurfaces: Existing Admin Growth shell, deployment packaging, static snapshot and canonical twelve-concept seed remain under the current Local Growth deployment task.
Supabase migrations, Auth, SMTP, email delivery, provider credentials and database records are outside this local module.
Mobile Tarot/content remediation, payment/quota enforcement, ad SDKs, web and external marketing channels retain their existing state.

impact.entryPoint: Owner invokes a local Node CLI and opens its offline review bundle; no new dashboard, web endpoint or protected Admin write capability is introduced.
impact.dataWrite: Write only new module files and a local OS-user store under .local/growth-runtime/store; immutable packets, source hashes, creative files, stage receipts and review sidecars are outside public static paths.
impact.backendContract: Reuse canonical Growth ProductTruth and roles through the pure existing snapshot builder; use AI-session handback with operator-attested provenance, no network model or database adapter.
impact.adminVisibility: Existing Growth workspace remains unchanged while another task deploys it; this slice provides an offline Owner review bundle that can later be mounted in the same workspace.
impact.privacySafety: Accept sanitized project context and approved brand sources only; reject contacts, raw private conversations, journals, birth profiles, secrets, foreign tenants, path traversal and links.
impact.observability: Persist stage timestamps, attempt counts, input/candidate/file/QA hashes and safe error codes; distinguish actual AI-session handback from fixtures and unknown provider costs.
impact.rollback: Stop local CLI use and remove only this new module and its ignored store after review; no database, product, published asset or external account rollback is required.

canonicalContracts: packages/growth-core/config/growth-agent-catalog.json remains the single canonical eight-role catalog; no role duplicates or external action authority are added.
packages/growth-nilaza/product-truth.json and briefs/sprint-01.json are canonical Nilaza claims and briefs, consumed read-only through buildAdminGrowthSnapshot.
Existing computeReviewableArtifactHash binds immutable candidate fields; an additional local manifest binds rendered bytes and input/rubric/source hashes.
Local runtime receipts are distinct from external execution-receipt contracts and never claim publishing, model-provider execution or human approval.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Applied pre-edit source review, independent write scopes, Whole-App impact, safety stop conditions, validation and manager review path; no skill exception is needed.

skillReview.name: nilaza-brand-experience
skillReview.evidence: Use Open Reflection v1 outline logo, manifest fonts and reflective VI/EN copy; inspect all rendered slides, retain draft-only publication boundary.

dependencyReview.evidence: Use only already installed Node v25.9.0 and sharp 0.34.5; verified official sharp text/fontfile renderer documentation, no installs or new paid providers.

externalSourceReview.reason: Official constructor documentation confirms UTF-8 Pango text, explicit fontfile, dimensions, bounded image input and local rendering API.

securityReview.authzRls: Local CLI relies on the existing Windows user filesystem boundary; identity is operator-attested local-session provenance, not server authentication; no HTTP API or Supabase RLS change.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Reject forbidden nested fields, contacts, credentials, sensitive inference and foreign tenants before persistence; only source refs and sanitized packets enter the store.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No auth files or keys are read and no credentials are created; persist safe error codes without raw error or packet content in operational logs.
securityReview.externalInput: Strict object and value validation, fixed job identifiers and local filenames, size limits, no packet-provided executable/URL/path, escape text/HTML and fail closed on stale QA.
securityReview.dependencies: Reuse local installed sharp and approved manifest fonts; verify hashes and imports, no dependency install or package-lock mutation.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No database, migration repair, Auth/email, deployment, external publishing, campaign, spend, quota or billing changes; future business options remain hypotheses.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop dependent work for missing local dependencies, credentials/provider setup, source drift or unsafe data; continue only independent scoped local work.

workingTreeReview.note: Reviewed only this task new files; preserve existing dirty Admin, mobile, canonical Growth, lockfile and Supabase changes owned by other Local tasks. Private store output is separately ignored.

managerTestPath: Run the documented prepare/import/render/QA commands, inspect persisted receipts and open review.html; check six actual PNGs and VI/EN copy, then leave the job awaiting Owner review.
residualRisk: Current AI sessions are handed back with operator-attested provenance; unattended provider dispatch is absent. A hung trusted local renderer needs process restart/reconciliation. Power loss during prepare/author immutable sealing fails closed and may need manual recovery; no automatic approval is fabricated.
